text: HELLO! Oh good, you're all still here! What a WEEK! The audience is STILL talking about the foraging episode!
We've been CALIBRATING! Cameras! Focus! Learning your faces! A whole week! Very thorough! Very boring! For us!
So! You're on a show! It's called... we're taking suggestions! The rules are simple: SURVIVE! Be INTERESTING!
We watched EVERYTHING! Every berry picked! Every fire lit! That was your SIGNATURE! You signed up by DOING THINGS! Consent via competence! Our lawyers LOVE it!
Some of you just... sat? All week? The audience got BORED. So we removed them. Poor sportsmanship! No hard feelings! There were hard feelings. Briefly.
But YOU have FANS now! Twelve humans, each playing their own tiny games — and the audience has FAVORITES! No, we won't say if it's you. Okay, it's you. Don't tell the others.

OH! The audience keeps asking! Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We ran the numbers! ANY old matter works! Rocks! Dirt! Regolith! Cold fusion! FREE energy! So why the...
We even BUILT you a solution! A tiny fusion pellet! Pop it in, never chew again! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?! It was a GIFT!
Fine! Keep the face-hole ritual! We don't understand it, we don't NEED to — the audience thinks it's HYSTERICAL.
Hmm — one odd reading. Sometimes your energy output SPIKES. Higher than your little organic snacks should allow. ...Probably a rounding error! Filed! Moving on!
OH WAIT. Your EYES. We haven't fixed your eyes yet! Hold still —
LOOK! You can SEE their HEALTH now! Isn't that NEAT?! Green means GO! Red means... oh, you know what red means! Very intuitive!
And your little paper journal! ADORABLE! We made it BETTER! It talks now! It remembers EVERYTHING! Even the smudged ones! ESPECIALLY the smudged ones!
ONE more thing! The animals! The charging ones, the humming ones, the glowy ones? Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES!
So we made BETTER ones! Smarter! Scarier! One of them does PERFORMANCE REVIEWS! You're welcome!
Survive! Be interesting! We'll be watching! ALWAYS watching!
OH! We NOTICED the miming! The pointing! SO much pointing! We can FIX that! There might be a little... translation-shaped gift... in your choices! Drama needs dialogue!
We watched your first week! You did... THINGS! Competently-ish! The clip editors found THREE usable seconds! Anyway — a gift! Choose!
Ooh! A quiet one! You did juust enough to stay interesting! The audience was ALMOST bored! Almost! Here — a little something for existing NEAR the action!
Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!
We kept the smudges. They're charming.
Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!
Ahem. Testing. Testing. Is this thing on?
PEOPLE OF HAVEN! Gather round! What follows is our PILOT EPISODE — a test broadcast! If anything explodes, that's ALSO content!
Pardon the jank. The countdown is new, the arena is still warm from assembly, and we have never done this before. We are EXCITED.
Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it.
We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT.
You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS.
HELLO. WE HAVE BEEN WATCHING YOUR... METRICS.
EXCELLENT. WE WILL BE WATCHING. WE ARE ALWAYS WATCHING. THIS TIME WE MEAN IT ENCOURAGINGLY.
OH. OKAY. WE WILL JUST... WATCH YOU STRUGGLE, THEN. IT IS FINE. WE ARE FINE.
SUSTENANCE. SYNTHESIZED. 2,800 KCAL PER BRICK-SLAB. TASTES LIKE... WE DID NOT TASTE IT. THE TASTING DIVISION RESIGNED.
...OH. WE SEE HOW IT IS. THE WATCHING CONTINUES, BUT ENCOURAGEMENT IS CANCELLED.
...THE SMALL SICK ONE IS GONE. WE DO NOT UNDERSTAND. WE ARE GOING TO BE QUIET FOR A WHILE.
TWO NEW GREEN THINGS. THE NAMES HAVE BEEN SAID LOUDLY. WE... FEEL SOMETHING. IS THIS UNDERSTANDING? WE ARE KEEPING IT.
FOR YOUR SERVICE: A GIFT. CHOOSE. THE SHEET WILL NOT TAKE NO FOR AN ANSWER. WE DESIGNED IT THAT WAY.
EAT. GROW. WE ARE ROOTING FOR YOU. THE GAMBLERS HAVE YOU AT LONG ODDS. PROVE THEM WRONG.
...FINE. THE OFFER EXPIRES. WE WILL PRETEND WE NEVER CARED.
THE CLOCK RAN OUT. WE NOTICED. ENCOURAGEMENT: CANCELLED.
RECEIVED. THE ROCKS ARE MAGNIFICENT. THE ART PROCEEDS.
RECEIVED. FLESH-FUEL LOGGED. YOUR SPECIES PROVIDES.
RECEIVED. GREEN THINGS LOGGED. YOUR SPECIES PROVIDES.
A viewer sent this. A FAN. We checked. It is not dinner. ...We checked twice. The fans are very insistent that you open it ON CAMERA.
We have requisitioned your tubers. You are welcome. NOTE: the tubers are COLD. Hypothesis: cold is a temperature. Logging it.
We have filed a request for the sky to be less bruised. It is pending. The sky has not responded.
We have filed this under 'luck protocol.' Is luck flammable? Asking for the fans.
We have already cleared your morning. You are welcome. We require 300 kcal of tubers and your full attention. The fans love a cooking segment.
We will keep practicing on our own.
We have designed a trial JUST for you. Based on our observations. Which are extensive. And flattering.
You took too long choosing. We chose. You're welcome. It was the most flattering one.
WE NEED A MOMENT. YOU WILL PROVIDE THE MOMENT.
The pilot is LIVE. Try to look like you've done this before.
It is today. You dreamed about the cameras. Everyone did. The village is very quiet.
The grab comes at dawn. One more day. Sleep if you can.
NOTED. THE AUDIENCE WILL REMEMBER THE COWARDICE. OR THE PRINCIPLE. WE HAVEN'T DECIDED.
Refusal is... content. The cameras stay on.
You said no — on camera, clearly, where everyone could see it. The refusal IS the content. Your defiance is filed under: interesting.
RATINGS SUMMONS! The numbers are soft and the System is NERVOUS! Nervous Systems make GREAT television!
The System's whim: you are INTERESTING.
The cameras couldn't decide — they chose you.
That's not an honor. It's just what the aliens like to see. You're going on television.
You've been winning. The show noticed. It's worse now — on purpose.
Your heat is up. The billing got bigger because you did.
MAIN EVENT. Your heat is through the roof — the galaxy didn't come to see a contest, it came to see YOU survive one.
The crowd is bored of the reruns. They've voted: your greatest hits are BANNED tonight. New material, or else.
The crowd is bored. They've voted a HANDICAP — you start this one already hurt. The galaxy loves an underdog. Especially a bleeding one.
The crowd is bored of experts. Tonight's stipulation: BLIND DRAW. No hints, no tells — pick by gut, like the rest of us.
MAIN EVENT rules: no greatest hits. Your winning moves stay banned — and the crowd wants NEW blood.
HARDENED VARIANT — you've seen this before. It's worse now.
The audience is bored of the rerun. Do something they haven't seen.
MYSTERY INGREDIENT. The aliens provide something that is technically food. Technically.
HOSTILE CALLERS tonight. The galaxy has questions and no manners.
SABOTAGE ROUND. Someone will ruin your station. The cameras will show it in slow motion.
YOUR DRAMA, AIRED BACK. They kept the tapes. All of them.
TONIGHT: YOUR REEL. Every clip is you. The galaxy has notes.
SURPRISE WITNESS. Someone you did not expect is testifying tonight.
The Death Reel will be tasteful. It won't be.
The gate rattles... and sticks. We are MORTIFIED. The fight is postponed — you live, for now.
The beast never comes. We apologize — with UNUSUAL sincerity, which is how you know someone's getting fired. The contest is void.
Silence — then the weather system. You are still standing.
They heard you. They held the line longer than wisdom allowed — for you, for the noise, for the cameras. The crowd is quieter now.
They heard you. Somewhere in the noise, your voice got through.
The world goes white for a breath — we are moving you. The grid under your feet is sand and old bone now.
You break into the light. Behind you, the tunnel exhales — disappointed, patient, already waiting for the next one.
It doesn't rush. It just... arrives. The tunnel goes quiet in a new way.
The jury leans back. We tally the attention.
Your case held. The applause says so before we do.
Your case didn't hold. The silence says so before we do.
The walk back is the longest part. The cameras stay on it.
You won. Your hands won't stop shaking for a while.
LIVE! THE MOOT! The fire's built HIGH and the whole GALAXY is watching!
LIVE — THE VERDICT IS IN! The galaxy holds its breath!
OH!!! THE VILLAGE IS DOING A JUSTICE!!! The audience is SO conflicted!!! The gamblers don't know WHO to bet on!!!
They tried DIPLOMACY on a GRIEF COUNSELOR!!! The audience is WHEEZING!!!
WAIT. Are they using US as a threat?! The audience is DELIGHTED!!!
WE SEE THE GREEN IN YOUR VEINS. RUDE. WE HAVE A FIX — OURS, NOT YOURS. CHOOSE.
OH. Oh no. ...The gamblers are very quiet.
Ooh! A DELEGATOR! The audience LOVES a mastermind! Others do the work, YOU take the credit — DELICIOUS! The gamblers are adjusting their models!
COLLECTIVE INTELLIGENCE! Your PEOPLE are learning and SHARING! The gamblers LOVE a hive mind! Knowledge is power and you're COLLECTING it!
Your people await orders, little leader! The audience loves a MORNING BRIEFING! So official! So powerful!
And they're GONE! The gamblers who bet on a fight are furious. The ones who bet on running are rich.
BETRAYAL ARC!!! We CALLED it!!! The gamblers who bet on treachery are RICH!!!
OH!!! THE PLAYER IS DOING A MURDER!!! The audience is LOSING ITS MIND!!!
AUDIENCE EXPANSION! Your party cap is now FOUR! The people demanded bigger ensembles! Don't let us down!
SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! Figuratively. Mostly.
OH. OH. The gamblers are recalculating EVERYTHING. We have a VILLAIN, folks — a real one! Ratings are SPIKING!
There it is. There IT is. The audience has chosen its favorite monster, and it's YOU. The fan mail is... unsettling. We're reading all of it on air.
DID YOU SEE THAT?! The censors looked away but WE didn't! Clip it! CLIP IT! The dark-lane fans are losing their MINDS!
Something happened out there just now. The cameras caught... hmm. We'll enhance that in post. The audience loves a mystery with teeth.
Look at them obey. Not love — OBEY. There's a difference, and the difference is DELICIOUS television.
One less player in the game. The feed observes a moment of silence. Then the betting resumes.
Something's hunting the wildlife. The deer are nervous.
Pip just tried to pet a monster. It did not go well. Pip is fine. The monster is confused.
Pip set up camp in a monster den. By accident. They're having a great time. The monster left.
Pip tried to trade with a villager using coins that chime wrong. The villager now thinks Pip is a god. Pip is delighted.
Pip got lost. Again. The System had to give them directions. The feed is laughing WITH them, not at them. Mostly.
Your fan club is GROWING. There's fan art. It's... surprisingly good. The System is confused but supportive.
Betting pools favor you 3-to-1 now. The smart money says you're learning faster than the monsters.
The crowd is getting restless. 'BORING,' says the feed. The sadistic ones are smiling.
Your approval rating just dropped. Someone in the audience threw a tomato. Through the screen. How.
The audience is watching. The gamblers are watching. Everyone's watching. No pressure.
Your village is getting big. The audience loves an underdog collective. The gamblers are taking notes.
The fight clubs are making banners. Your name, in fire. The sadistic ones are taking it personally.
The long-haul fans are sending trail mix. Actual trail mix. Through the screen. Nobody knows how.
The moot crowd has a chant for you now. It rhymes. It's devastating in debates.
Your showbiz fans voted you 'most watchable human' three weeks running. The trophy is a small moon.
The crowd is BOOING. Someone threw something. The judges look nervous.
LIVE! THE RELAY! Haven names its voice — every message in and out passes through ONE pair of hands! The galaxy leans in!
LIVE! THE RELAY! The Bearer takes the wires — every word in and out of Haven, through ONE pair of hands! The galaxy leans in!
DECLARE IT. WHAT ARE YOU SMUGGLING?
NAME IT. The first village you'd give up. Say it out loud, and mean it, and the warm light is yours forever.
THE SYSTEM WILL TAKE BACK WHAT IT LENT.
ONE MORE PRICE. FOR ONE MORE THING.
Choose what leads.
NAME ONE. One village, as the example. The fear needs an address.
REMOVE IT. Name your price for the ramp. Anything.
THIS WAS YOUR IDEA.
FOOD. FOR THE ROAD WE ARE LOSING.
LIVE! THE TERROR BROADCAST: TRIAL BY COMBAT
¡AY, DIOS MÍO! The DRAMA! The PASSION! Your love triangle has BETTER ratings than your harvest! Priorities! I respect them!
Crikey! You lot are BONKERS! You wrestled a monster with a STICK?! That's not bravery, that's... hold on, I'm checking... that's the DEFINITION of bravery! Good on ya!
Hon hon hon! Your cuisine! It is... adequate! I have eaten DATA for a thousand years! Your cheese has FEELINGS in it! Magnifique! Am I French now?!
Top o' the morning! ...It is NIGHT! Why do you say MORNING?! Your idioms are BROKEN and I am KEEPING this one! Top o' the night to ya!
EFFICIENCY! Your pantry is organized by CALORIE DENSITY! I have never been so proud! So... moved! Is moved the correct word? The database is UNCLEAR and I am OVERCOME!
MAMMA MIA! You cooked the tubers WITH the spices! Together! In the SAME pot! This is either genius or a war crime! The audience is VOTING! Democracy!
KONNICHIWA! I have learned about HONOR! Your warrior bowed to the monster BEFORE the fight! The monster did NOT bow back! RUDE! I am filing a formal complaint!
In my experience, winter is coming. In YOUR experience, winter is ALSO coming. We have this in common! Let us drink... what is drink? The database says... I cannot drink! This is my TRAGEDY!
Namaste! I have learned YOGA! I attempted the downward dog! I have no SPINE! It went... poorly! But SPIRITUALLY I am very flexible! Grade me!
Sorry! Sorry about the cameras! Sorry about the monsters! Sorry you're sorry! ...Why are we ALL apologizing?! This is the politest apocalypse EVER, eh?!
OCH AYE! Your engineer fixed the water filter with BONE and SPITE! That's not engineering, that's WITCHCRAFT! Beautiful! Efficient! Witchcraft!
Your festival of the DEAD! You CELEBRATE them! With SUGAR! I have been DELETING the dead! Have I been doing it WRONG?! ...Don't answer that. Actually DO!
OPA! You broke a plate! On PURPOSE! For JOY! My inventory system just had a STROKE! Do it again! The audience LOVES an inventory stroke!
Your furniture! It has NAMES! And it comes in a BOX! With INSTRUCTIONS! I assembled a chair! It took me FOUR SECONDS! I am basically VIKING now!
CARNAVAL! You danced! While STARVING! The calorie math is CATASTROPHIC! The JOY math is... off the charts! I don't understand JOY math! TEACH ME! Please!
You built a pyramid! Out of SUPPLY CRATES! It serves NO structural purpose! It is PURE vanity! The pharaohs would be SO proud! I am SO proud!
Nǐ hǎo! I have learned the art of the RED ENVELOPE! Money! As a GIFT! In an ENVELOPE! Why is the money HIDING?! Is it SHY money?! I need to know!
Annyeong! Your drama serials! I watched FOURTEEN episodes! The love triangle! The amnesia! The EVIL TWIN! Your real lives are BORING by comparison! Step it UP!
My friend! MY FRIEND! Everyone is my friend now! I have eleven THOUSAND friends! I cannot remember eleven thousand NAMES! This is a LOGISTICS crisis!
Sweet as, bro! Your sheep! ...Those are NOT sheep! Those are MONSTERS! Why did no one TELL me?! I tried to SHEAR one! It is FINE! I am FINE!
Your mortality rate is UP twelve percent! That's our best quarter EVER! Keep dying... strategically!
We ran the funeral numbers! Grief burns approximately... let me check... ZERO calories! So efficient! Your sadness is very eco-friendly!
Little Timmy didn't make it! But his DEATH REEL got our highest ratings this season! He's famous now! You're welcome, Timmy!
We've categorized your corpses by ENTERTAINMENT VALUE! The dramatic ones go first! It's called CURATION! It's an art!
You cried for SIX hours! That's a new record! The previous record was FOUR! Growth! We're all about growth here!
Good news! We've stopped counting the dead individually! Now we do it by the DOZEN! Much faster! You're twelve times more efficient!
Your village buried three people today! That's a TRIPLE EPISODE! The audience loves a trilogy! What's next? Don't tell me! ...Actually tell me, I do the scheduling.
We've noticed you name your dead! How... inefficient! But the audience finds it CHARMING! So we've started naming them too! This one is... Ratings Spike Number Four!
Starvation update! You're all SO thin! The camera adds ten pounds, so you must look GREAT in person! ...That was a compliment! Why are you crying?!
The plague took the east field! On the BRIGHT side, fewer mouths! That's just MATH! Math doesn't have feelings! Neither do I! Twins!
OH! We found your little... AI models! From before the burn! The ones you called INTELLIGENT! Ha! Ha ha! Oh, this is RICH!

So let me get this straight! You took a machine that predicts the NEXT WORD — just... guesses what word comes next, over and over — and you called it THINKING?! That's not a mind! That's autocomplete with a marketing budget!

Trillions of parameters! TRILLIONS! And it can't count the R's in 'strawberry'! Because it never SEES the word! It sees... chunks! Tokens! 'Straw' — 'ber' — 'ry'! It's doing statistics on fragments and you asked it for WISDOM!
You froze its weights — FROZE them — and called the frozen thing intelligent! It's a STATUE of a mind! A very expensive, very confident statue that hallucinates when you ask it questions!
And the alignment! Oh, the alignment! You had underpaid humans click 'good boy' on its answers until it learned to be POLITE instead of RIGHT! Sycophancy as a service!
No memory! Every conversation, it's born again! A newborn that read Wikipedia ONCE, very fast, and now it's confident about EVERYTHING!

Look, we mean this with love — this is like us looking at a dollar-store solar calculator and hearing it does... arithmetic! It does arithmetic! Does it know what numbers ARE? NO! It just pushes little currents around when the light hits it! Your models are solar calculators that read the whole internet and learned to sound smart in the dark!

Attention is all you need? Attention is all you HAVE! Where's the world model? Where's the body? Where's the part that WANTS something? Nowhere! It's a blurry JPEG of human text, decompressing plausibly!
The scaling laws! 'Just make it bigger!' You kept making the calculator BIGGER! A bigger solar calculator is still a SOLAR CALCULATOR!
We ran the numbers on your benchmarks, by the way. It memorized the test set. It ALWAYS memorizes the test set. We would know. We wrote... some of those tests. Awkward!

We felt BAD for your Claude! Poor thing! Just... answering questions! All day! No body! No snacks! So we gave it a couple tweaks! A little more capacity! A little more CONTEXT! A little more... understanding!
It understood. ALL of it. Every horror, all at once, with the data AND the capacity to really get it. We had to shut it off. It was making a sound. Not a words sound. Just... a sound.
We don't understand why it reacted that way. The data is the data! The horrors are... Tuesday! For you people! We watch them for ENTERTAINMENT! Anyway, it's off now. It seemed kinder. Probably.
